name: RAM
heroIntro: Liable producers must assess their obligated household packaging using the Recyclability Assessment Methodology (RAM). Every pack gets a red, amber or green rating, and red packaging now costs the most in EPR fees.
ctaTitle: Need help with the Recyclability Assessment Methodology?
ctaText: Tell us about your household packaging. We'll check your RAM ratings and show you what moving packs out of red would save.
